svg.title: Four network graphs: (a) a Hopfield network, a complete graph on visible units; (b) a Boltzmann machine, a complete graph on hidden units h_1 to h_3 and visible units v_1 to v_4; (c) a restricted Boltzmann machine, a complete bipartite graph between a visible layer x and a hidden layer h; (d) a deep belief network, a stack of such bipartite layers x, h^(1), h^(2), h^(3) of decreasing size.
